title: THE PIXEL TREE, BUSH AND SHADOW
why: Job 86d ship 2: with the pixel look on, a canopy and a bush bake once at one pixel per 2 world units in the map leaf palette with hard alpha and a dark bottom and right edge, the trunk is drawn at art pixels, and a ground shadow is a hard pixel ellipse a little bigger and darker.
now: With the pixel look on (the default), trees, bushes and ground shadows are chunky hard-edged pixels. With the look off, nothing changes.
